name: icu Date toLocaleString default fields per locale
source: function main(): void { const d = new Date(Date.UTC(2024, 0, 15, 13, 5, 9)); console.log(d.toLocaleString("en-US", { timeZone: "UTC" })); console.log(d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { timeZone: "UTC" })); console.log(d.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", { timeZone: "UTC" })); console.log(d.toLocaleString("en-GB", { timeZone: "UTC" })); console.log(d.toLocaleString("de-DE", { timeZone: "UTC" })); console.log(d.toLocaleString("fr-FR", { timeZone: "UTC" })); console.log(d.toLocaleString("ja-JP", { timeZone: "UTC" })); console.log(d.toLocaleString("es-ES", { timeZone: "UTC" })); console.log(d.toLocaleDateString("ko-KR", { timeZone: "UTC" })); console.log(d.toLocaleTimeString("de-DE", { timeZone: "UTC" })); }
